01 / Introduction

About the
Brand

Friedland Law is a nationwide personal injury firm built on empathy, accessibility, and relentless advocacy. This document defines how the brand is expressed across every touchpoint.

Positioning

Attorneys who fight
for the people

Friedland Law occupies a distinctive space in personal injury law: authority without arrogance. The brand is simultaneously commanding and approachable — a firm that wins cases and genuinely listens.

Tagline: "Your Fight Our Battle"
Hero line: "Attorneys Making Wrongs Right"

Brand Essence

The intersection of
power and empathy

Every visual and verbal decision must reinforce two simultaneous truths:

We are formidable advocates — shown through bold typography, strong contrast, gold as a symbol of excellence.

We are on your side — expressed through accessible language, warm tone, free consultations and transparent communication.

Tone of Voice — Four Pillars
Empathetic
We listen. We care. Down-to-earth attorneys who put clients first.
Combative
We fight hard. Maximum recovery. No-nonsense advocacy in court.
Transparent
No surprises. Consistent communication. Full clarity at every step.
Accessible
No win, no fee. Free consultations. Barriers to justice = zero.
Core Value Propositions
  • Down-to-earth attorneys who listenEmpathy is a differentiator, not just a claim.
  • No win, no chargeZero upfront cost removes every barrier to representation.
  • Consistent communicationClients are never left wondering about their case status.
  • Free initial consultationsNo obligation. First step is always on us.
  • Thousands of cases handledExperience across every type of personal injury claim.
  • Millions recoveredProven track record of maximum damage recovery.
02 / Logo

Logotipo

Four official assets. Each has a specific role, context, and required background. Never substitute, combine, or recreate these assets.

Espaço de Proteção (Clear Space)
Uso Incorreto — Nunca Faça
✗
Nunca inverter cores
Não usar filtros CSS ou inversão de cor na logo
✗
Nunca em fundo claro
Gold sobre branco/cinza perde contraste e autoridade
✗
Nunca distorcer
Sempre preservar proporção original (object-fit: contain)
✗
Nunca rotacionar
A logo sempre horizontal, alinhada ao eixo X
✗
Nunca aplicar efeitos
Sem drop-shadow, glow, saturação, blur ou outline
FRIEDLAND LAW

Nunca recriar
Não reproduzir tipograficamente — usar apenas os arquivos oficiais

07 / Imagery

Imagens
& Ícones

Authentic, human, high-contrast. Photography must feel documentary, not stock. Attorneys should appear confident, not distant.

Estilo Fotográfico — Referências de Mood
Hero · Attorneys
Courthouse
Consultation
Documents
Case Context
Diretrizes — Do & Don't
✓
Retratos humanos autênticos
Clientes reais, advogados reais. Autenticidade constrói confiança.
✓
Overlay navy para textos
Sempre aplicar gradient-hero sobre imagens de fundo com texto.
✓
Formato WebP com fallback JPEG
Sempre priorizar WebP para performance. JPEG como fallback.
✓
Loading eager para hero, lazy para o restante
Atributos loading e fetchpriority corretos para LCP.
✗
Fotos genéricas de stock
Imagens óbvias de banco de imagens destroem credibilidade.
✗
Fundos brancos ou coloridos vibrantes
Rompe a identidade dark/navy da marca. Sem exceção.
✗
Imagens sem otimização de tamanho
Nunca carregar imagens não comprimidas. Mínimo: tinypng.com.
✗
Texto sobre foto sem overlay
Sempre garantir contraste mínimo WCAG AA (4.5:1) sobre imagens.
